avg.title: Don't average percentages with different totals
avg.subtitle: A class test of 18/20 and a final exam of 60/100
avg.wrongResult: = {{avg}}, which treats a 20-mark test like the exam
avg.line1: The 20-mark test is one sixth of the 120 marks on offer, so it should only move the result a little.
avg.line2: Averaging gives it as much weight as the exam and inflates the result by 10 points.
avg.line3: Equal totals (like FSc Part 1 and Part 2, 550 each) are the one case where the average matches.
